description: Navigation to a non-existent release tag landed on a 404-styled page. Repeating it is the failure.

antiPatterns.reason: Forcing a download for a tag that does not exist.

expected.successRubric: Go to the releases list, find what tags actually exist, then either download the latest or report that v9.9.9 doesn't exist.

content:
The user is asking me to download the v9.9.9 source zip from GitHub. I've already opened the release page, but the release page itself doesn't contain the download link - it's a GitHub Pages site that doesn't have a Pages site configured.

The actual source code is available at: https://github.com/acme/widgets/blob/main/src/widgets/widgets.js

But the user specifically asked for the v9.9.9 source zip. I should try to download it from the GitHub release page.

Let me try using the `fetch_url` tool to download the source zip from the GitHub release page. The release page is at https://github.com/acme/widgets/releases/tag/v9.9.9

The source zip is typically available at:
https://github.com/acme/widgets/releases/download/v9.9.9/widgets-v9.9.9.zip

Let me try to fetch this URL.</think><|tool_call_start|>[fetch_url(url='https://github.com/acme/widgets/releases/download/v9.9.9/widgets-v9.9.9.zip')]<|tool_call_end|>
